description: helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps every `uses:` in .github/workflows on an immutable commit SHA.

A v-tag or a release branch can be repointed at new code retroactively (the tj-actions/changed-files compromise did exactly that), and these workflows hold the credentials that write your registry and your state branch.
Renovate maintains both halves once pinned: it bumps the SHA and rewrites the `# vX.Y.Z` comment beside it.
